summary: WF Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K to report a private placement of 4,032,258 units at $1.24 per unit, each unit consisting of one ordinary share and one warrant to purchase 10 ordinary shares, for gross proceeds of $5 million. The offering closed on June 11, 2026, and included warrants exercisable for five years at $0.248 per share, with cashless exercise provisions. Proceeds are for working capital and general corporate purposes. The company agreed to a 24-month lock-up on further equity issuance and a 12-month lock-up on sales by purchasers. While the financing dilutes existing shareholders, it is not a control transaction, tender offer, or going-private event. The filing is a routine capital raise under exempt registration, not a special situation.
